corpus_revision_note: Revision 1 (commit e24e495) is superseded. It extracted pages 900-27 to 900-46 with pdftotext -layout, which interleaved the two MPEP columns line by line and destroyed reading order. Revision 2 narrows the scope to pages 900-40 to 900-46 and extracts in raw mode, restoring correct reading order. See port-004.correction-note.v0.1.md.

composition.leading_spill_content: Closing text of 903.09 at the top of 900-40: Patent Transfer Inquiry (PTI) system and patent file wrapper handling.
composition.trailing_spill_content: Opening text of 905 / 905.01 at the foot of 900-46: CPC classification scheme hierarchy and section symbols.

excluded: 902 Search Tools and Classification Information and subsections
903 Classification in USPC and subsections, including the 903.08 family application assignment, inspection and transfer procedure material (except the 903.09 leading spill noted above)
905 Cooperative Patent Classification and subsections (except the trailing spill noted above)
all remaining Chapter 900 material on pages 900-1 to 900-39 and 900-47 to 900-58
frozen_scope.exclusion_rationale: Narrowed from revision 1 to keep the frozen input as close as possible to a single bounded operational workflow, to avoid unrelated classification administration material, to avoid the 901.08 spill present in revision 1, and to avoid an artificial multi-range assembly step.

limitations: Section 904.02(b) decision tree exists as a graphic and is not visible to text-only ingestion.
OCR recovery was audit-only and must NOT be added to engine input.
Actual examiner behaviour and time constraints are not represented.

Boundary spill is present and unedited: 300 characters of 903.09 at the start and 1,143 characters of 905/905.01 at the end. Page-contiguity was preserved in preference to trimming, so that no editorial decision enters the frozen corpus.
The document cites USPTO intranet resources that are referenced but not reproduced, so the public document does not disclose the full internal procedure.
